description: Volcanoes, atmosphere, ice, oceans, planetary rarity and tsunamis reveal the physical forces that made Earth habitable while keeping it dangerously dynamic.

s02e01.description: Iain Stewart investigates volcano, using landscapes, geology and field evidence to show how Earth’s physical processes shaped environments and human history.
